defeat: The labyrinth keeps what it kills.
Somewhere, a cartographer adds your name.
Your Embers cool where you fell.
The stone remembers the way down.
Even the Emaciated Man looks away.
The halls fold shut behind you.
The Scavenger will find your boots.
You will wake at the Threshold again.
victory: Behind you, the labyrinth forgets your name.
The Umbra loosens its grip. For now.
You step into a morning you had stopped believing in.
The dark will need a new story.
embrace: Wisdom is knowing which door to leave by.
The Embers come with you. The dark stays.
